_doc: Generated SFX recipes, written by scripts/sfx/generate.py (`recipes` step) from scripts/sfx/gen-prompts.json and the automatic picks; build.py and catalogue.py merge this into recipes.json. Sources are .cache/sfx/dl/gen/<name>_NN.wav (picked, trimmed TangoFlux takes). Do not edit by hand: change gen-prompts.json (an item's `recipe` holds the catalogue fields and build overrides) and re-run.

recipes.name: phone_vibrate_table
recipes.what: Phone vibrating on the wooden coffee table: two buzzes, rattling against the wood
recipes.ch: Ch1 phone hotspot (12 unread) and the notification before it

recipes.name: watch_buzz_wrist
recipes.what: Smartwatch haptic buzz on the wrist, close and muffled
recipes.ch: Every ui.watchBuzz (Ch1 TIME TO MOVE, Ch2 PAUSE?, Ch4 ROWING DETECTED / 3 hr 12 min, Ch5 last menu)
recipes.replaces: audio.buzz() (keep the HUD shake as the twin)
recipes.bus: not used: one weak take; keep the procedural buzz()

recipes.name: tv_crt_off
recipes.what: CRT television switched off: button click, thump, fading whine
recipes.ch: Ch1 TV hotspot: E turns it off and the key light dies
recipes.replaces: new (cut tv_race_bed at the same moment)

recipes.name: boot_step_wood
recipes.what: Walking-boot step on old floorboards: flat plastic clump, slight creak
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat and Ch4 workshop: the bad-leg step
recipes.replaces: footstep('concrete', rate 0.72) + thud in Player._steps when footsteps==='boot' indoors
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.35, +-4% rate; alternate with step_wood for the good foot

recipes.name: boot_step_wet
recipes.what: Walking-boot step on wet asphalt: flat clump with a small splash
recipes.ch: Ch2 and Ch5 street: the bad-leg step outdoors

recipes.name: run_step_wet
recipes.what: Running-shoe step on a wet road, light splash
recipes.ch: Ch3 rhythm, rain weeks (Week 20 heavier: volume up, rate 0.92)
recipes.replaces: footstep('concrete') in the Ch3 rhythm (run_step stays for Week 9)

recipes.name: breath_run_loop
recipes.what: Runner's steady mouth breathing at cadence (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch3 run: under the steps, gain follows cadence; ragged after the crack (rate 1.1, more gain)

recipes.name: crack_pencil_lead
recipes.what: Tiny dry snap, like a pencil lead breaking inside a drawer
recipes.ch: Ch3 KM 31 [crack]
recipes.replaces: audio.snap() (keep the tone() whine); plays on fx through cut()
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.5, lowpass 3 kHz for the 'inside a drawer' distance

recipes.name: fluoro_flicker
recipes.what: Failing fluorescent tube: ballast buzz stuttering, starter click, glassy tink as it strikes
recipes.ch: Ch1 tube stutter every 6-9 s; Ch4 Day 5 flicker
recipes.replaces: the bandpass 120 Hz noise burst + tick in scene1.js / scene4/lights.js (fluoro_hum stays the steady part)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.2, distance gain with the tube

recipes.name: club_pass_wet
recipes.what: Group of runners splashing past on a wet street at night, approach and fade
recipes.ch: Ch2 run club in the rain (Ch5 keeps club_pass)
recipes.replaces: the per-runner footstep() loop in ch2.js
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.5; StereoPanner swept +Z to -Z over the pass

recipes.name: paint_lid_open
recipes.what: Paint-tin lid prised off with a screwdriver: pop and light scrape
recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 mixer start (five tins), Ch5 Hugo's panel
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.5 (peaky: up to 9 dB under target)

recipes.name: paint_stir_loop
recipes.what: Stick stirring thick paint in an enamel pot (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 mixer: a 0.4 s swirl after each drop and while the swatch eases
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.3; play slices for the swirl

recipes.name: paint_drop
recipes.what: One thick drop of paint into paint: soft viscous plop
recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 mixer drop
recipes.replaces: the plip tone(900->400 Hz) in crafts/mixer.js (keep it as fallback)

recipes.name: paint_slosh
recipes.what: Thick paint tipped out of an enamel pot: slow slosh and glug
recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 mixer: Tip it out
recipes.replaces: the lowpass 500 Hz noise in crafts/mixer.js

recipes.name: tape_pull
recipes.what: Steel tape-measure blade pulled out: metallic whirr and spring ratchet (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 Measure twice: while Space/mouse is held
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.3; playbackRate 0.7-1.2 from blade speed (60 -> 4 cm/s)

recipes.name: tape_retract
recipes.what: Tape-measure blade zipping back and clacking shut
recipes.ch: Ch4 tape: too short, the blade zips back
recipes.replaces: the highpass 2400 Hz noise in crafts/tape.js

recipes.name: tape_tock
recipes.what: Tape-measure case touching a wooden door frame: one small hollow tock
recipes.ch: Ch4 tape: the case meets the jamb at 81.5 cm (info cue; the loupe is its twin)
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.4, +-5% rate; one take, so alternate with table_tock at rate 1.3, volume 0.3

recipes.name: freewheel_tick
recipes.what: Rear-hub freewheel ticking while the wheel coasts (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch4 Week 4 and Ch5 Ines's wheel while it turns; Ch5 Sami coasting

recipes.name: freewheel_coastdown
recipes.what: Wheel spun by hand, freewheel ticking slowing to a stop
recipes.ch: Ch4 Week 4 done ('spins true and silent'); Sami spinning it in [after]

recipes.name: brake_rub
recipes.what: Rim brushing a brake pad once: short soft 'zhhh'
recipes.ch: Ch4 Week 4 / Ch5 truing rub (Sami's 'zhhh, zhhh')
recipes.replaces: audio.tick() in W.bike.onRub / rig.onRub (volume from deviation; the pad flash is the twin)

recipes.name: chain_drop
recipes.what: Bicycle chain falling off the chainring: rattle and slap
recipes.ch: Ch5 [teach]: Sami's chain drops
recipes.replaces: the highpass noise + tick in ch5.js

recipes.name: chain_on
recipes.what: Chain hooked back on while the pedal turns backwards: clicks and a seating clunk
recipes.ch: Ch5 [teach]: correct answer, 'It went on'

recipes.name: shutter_runner_scrape
recipes.what: One push on a stuck rusty roller shutter: slats grinding in the runners
recipes.ch: Ch5 job (a) shutter: one per stroke
recipes.replaces: scrapeAt() there (sand_stroke at rate 1.3 was the stand-in)
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.35-0.5 by stroke strength, +-5% rate

recipes.name: shutter_roll_up
recipes.what: Corrugated roller shutter rolling up freely, clunk at the top
recipes.ch: Ch5 job (a) done: rolls up over 1.6 s

recipes.name: watch_hang_nail
recipes.what: Watch hung on a nail: small metallic clink, soft strap tap
recipes.ch: Ch5 [walk.watch]: the watch on the nail
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.4; weak match, listen first (keep tick() or spoke_key_02 otherwise)

recipes.name: tool_hook
recipes.what: Hand tool lifted off a pegboard hook: short scrape and clink
recipes.ch: Ch4 pegboard (sandpaper, plane, spoke key)
recipes.replaces: audio.scrape({volume:0.12}) on taking a tool (tool_take, a bench pick-up, was the stand-in)
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.55 (the files are peak-limited 6-7.5 dB under target)

recipes.name: amb_workshop
recipes.what: Quiet workshop room tone: faint hum, street through a half-open garage door, light rain on the roof (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch4 bed for all four days (Day 5 with rain; other days low-pass it or keep it very low)

recipes.name: amb_stairwell
recipes.what: Old stairwell at night: concrete reverb, timer light, distant TV (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch1 door beat: under the fade to black as he leaves (optional)
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.3, fade in with the door

recipes.name: radio_talk_fishing
recipes.what: Small-speaker AM talk radio, a calm man talking, indistinct (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch4 radio hotspot and Ch5 radio fishing station (optional)
recipes.replaces: optional upgrade of radioVoice's formant voice (crafts/radio.js); TTS through the radio band is preferred
recipes.bus: radio band (hp 300 / lp 3400), gain as radioVoice

recipes.name: chalk_line
recipes.what: Chalk drawn along a rough painted brick wall: short dry scratch
recipes.ch: Ch5 Odile's chalk guide (optional)

recipes.name: step_wood_alt
recipes.what: Shoe step on old wooden floorboards
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat and Ch4 workshop floor (the good foot)

recipes.name: creak_wood_alt
recipes.what: Wooden bench creak under weight
recipes.ch: Ch2/Ch5 bench sit; Ch5 panel ladder; Ch4 door hung in the frame

recipes.name: mug_clink_alt
recipes.what: Ceramic mug set down on a wooden table: light clink
recipes.ch: Ch1 seed: the mug on the table settles

recipes.name: pencil_erase_alt
recipes.what: Eraser rubbing out a pencil line
recipes.ch: Ch5 walk.notebook: the strike lifted off 'Ride.' and 'Run.'
